fog_rendering.sampling: 5D unscrambled Sobol, half-cell shifted; volume-weighted tetrahedra and normalized exponential barycentric weights
fog_rendering.reconstruction: projected weighted histogram followed by normalized Gaussian convolution
fog_rendering.visibility_normalization: total support optical mass = common mean optical depth times projected full-mesh silhouette area
fog_rendering.concentration: within-method 50-point full-covariance Scott KDE log-Q05/Q95; weight .8+.2*concentration
fog_rendering.composition: approximate common projected-depth slabs, representative mass-weighted mean depth, jointly ordered with all 250 measured centers
fog_rendering.vector_approximation: 48 nested midpoint optical-depth contour levels per field; no contour lines

observation_rendering.radial_opacity: exp(-4.5*r**2) times smoothstep((1-r)/.25), sampled at 41 stops on normalized radius [0,1]

palette_meaning: method hue identity; fog concentration is qualitative within method, not cross-method accuracy
